notes: BUG EXPOSED (report only, no patch): When LangGraphParityRuntimeV2.run() was patched to loop forever, execute_run() hung for the full 5-second external timeout. There is no internal timeout/circuit-breaker in execute_run to abort a stalled graph invocation and return status=failed. This is a failure-mode gap: a long-running or stuck graph node could keep the request thread occupied indefinitely. No source code modified.
